SELECT e.Name
FROM employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT Employee_ID, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM evaluation
    GROUP BY Employee_ID
    ORDER BY award_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_awards ON e.Employee_ID = top_awards.Employee_ID; 
FINAL SQL:
SELECT e.Name
FROM employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT Employee_ID, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM evaluation
    GROUP BY Employee_ID
    ORDER BY award_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_awards ON e.Employee_ID = top_awards.Employee_ID;
